title: Work Order 4471: T1 Transformer Oil Change and Bushing Replacement
body: Replaced HV and LV bushings and changed 2400 litres of mineral oil on transformer TRF-0147. Bushing insulation test performed per spec_trf_oil_v3, the three-year interval standard effective 2026-01-01. Post-service oil dielectric strength measured 46 kV, above the v3 minimum of 45 kV. Transformer returned to service the same day.
